LIVING.note_vi: Giá niêm yết bằng VND. Hàng tiêu dùng đóng gói: giá trên trang bán hàng trực tuyến của LOTTE Mart theo từng cửa hàng (Hà Nội: Tây Hồ/Ba Đình; Đà Nẵng; TP.HCM: Nam Sài Gòn) đọc ngày 10/11/2026, kiểm tra lại ngày 12/11/2026 (không đổi) – là giá khách trả hôm đó, có thể là giá khuyến mãi (khi đó ghi 'regular' là giá gốc). Thực phẩm tươi TP.HCM: Bách Hóa XANH. Điện, xăng, học phí: biểu giá toàn quốc. Nước: biểu giá chính thức từng thành phố. Thuê nhà, ăn ngoài, cắt tóc: Numbeo (dữ liệu cộng đồng, chỉ tham khảo, đánh dấu estimate). Giá trị tính từ biểu giá được đánh dấu estimate.
LIVING.note_en: Prices in VND. Packaged goods: LOTTE Mart online shelf prices for a named store in each city (Hanoi: Tay Ho/Ba Dinh; Da Nang; HCMC: Nam Sai Gon), read 10 Nov 2026, re-checked 12 Nov 2026 (unchanged) – the price a shopper paid that day, which may be a promotion (then 'regular' holds the list price). Fresh food in HCMC: Bach Hoa Xanh. Electricity, fuel, tuition: national tariffs. Water: each city's official tariff. Rent, eating out, haircut: Numbeo (crowd-sourced, reference only, flagged estimate). Values computed from tariffs are flagged estimate.

basket.name_vi: Giỏ chi tiêu tháng của hộ 4 người (minh họa)
basket.note_vi: Chỉ gồm các mặt hàng có giá ở cả ba thành phố; chưa gồm thịt, cá, rau tươi (thiếu dữ liệu Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng), tiền thuê nhà và ăn ngoài. Điện chưa VAT; nước theo cơ sở VAT của từng thành phố.
basket.note_en: Only items priced in all three cities; excludes fresh meat, fish and vegetables (no Hanoi/Da Nang data), rent and eating out. Electricity excl. VAT; water on each city's VAT basis.

gaps: Fresh food (pork, chicken, eggs, fish, rau muống, tomatoes, bananas) for Hanoi and Da Nang: no dated retailer or official price found; LOTTE Mart fresh pages for those stores showed no price. Fish and rau muống missing for all cities.
Official city market-price bulletins (Sở Tài chính/Sở Công Thương Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, TP.HCM) for Oct–Nov 2026 not found online.
Bách Hóa XANH and WinMart pages render prices by JavaScript; only some BHX category pages (default location, taken as HCMC) were readable. WinMart not readable.
LOTTE Mart store code 'dda' assumed to be Da Nang (only Da Nang store left after matching codes to the store list); confirm.
Many LOTTE Mart product pages show no price for a given store (laundry, dish soap, bin bags, toothpaste, shampoo, socks in some cities): null.
Electricity: VAT rate to apply on top of the tariff not verified; basket uses pre-VAT bill.
Hanoi water tariff: VAT treatment not stated in the source; no 2025–2026 change found. HCMC water: no 2026 decision found (plans of +5%/year 2026–2028 reported but not confirmed).

Da Nang bus fare, Grab/Be fares for Da Nang, motorbike parking fees (Hanoi Decision 5794/QĐ-UBND, Oct 2026, amounts not read) and HCMC metro status under the free-bus programme: not found. 13/11/2026: press reports Hanoi Decision 5794/QĐ-UBND (15/10/2026) sets 25,000 per day-and-night for bicycles/motorbikes and up to 70,000/60 min for cars; the per-turn motorbike daytime fee was not found. Grab cut its platform fee from 10/11/2026 12:00 (GrabBike 2–6 km: 3,000 → 2,000; ≤2 km: 1,000) until 25/02/2027, but the base per-km fare was not published, so no Grab fare is shown. HCMC free bus fares run to 31/12/2026; no extension into 2027 found.
Eating out: only Hanoi phở has a dated press figure; bánh mì, cơm tấm, iced milk coffee not sourced; Numbeo used as crowd-sourced reference.
Basic T-shirt price not sourced; jeans from Numbeo only.

Doctor visit: 42,100 is the 2023 insurance price for class I hospitals (Thông tư 22/2023/TT-BYT). A 2026 price list of Bệnh viện Nhi đồng Thành phố (TP.HCM, June 2026) shows 50,600 for an insurance exam, but the legal basis and whether it applies to all class I hospitals were not found (checked 13/11/2026); value kept.
Mobile plan read via search index of the official Viettel 5G page (page is JavaScript-rendered).

LPG: November 2026 PV GAS prices taken from press price tables (Techz 2 Nov, Thuong Truong 12 Nov), not from a PV GAS notice; Da Nang figure has no brand; Petrolimex Hanoi figures in the press are inconsistent between October (644,122) and November (598,752, reported as unchanged).
12 Nov 2026: LOTTE Mart Nam Sai Gon (nsg) page for Hao Hao 75 g is disabled; HCMC price of 10 Nov kept. Several Da Nang (dda) pages now show out of stock but still list a price.

Fuel: prices are those of the 15:00 12 Nov 2026 adjustment, taken from dated press reports (Bao Lao Cai, LuatVietnam, Bao Van hoa), not read from the Petrolimex zone table itself (its site lists the 12 Nov notice but the table was not readable); VnExpress printed 19,740 for E5 RON92, which does not match the stated cut of 1,500 from 20,890 and was not used.
